title: Explainable ML links dental calculus to severe radiation oral mucositis
summary: The model reached AUC 0.904 on an independent test set of 430 retrospective patients and identified dental calculus index 2 as a key risk factor. In a 148-patient prospective intervention cohort, controlling calculus coincided with severe mucositis in 8.1%, a 31% decrease. The prospective cohort was observational and not randomized, in one country.
